title: Rippers Unmasked — 1892 Equipment
description: The campaign's QA'd 1892-rethemed basic gear as native Project FU Item packs the GM drags onto sheets and shop tables: 21 basic weapons, 9 armor + 2 shields, and 8 services, each in the 1892 register with its faithful £/s/d price. Mechanics and prices verbatim from the Core Rulebook basic-equipment tables; no automation code. Original campaign content, layered on Project FU. A personal-table module — not for redistribution.

rippers-equipment.note: Native Project FU Item packs (pack system:projectfu): type:weapon (21), type:armor + type:shield (9+2), type:treasure (8 services). Built from lodge-docs/EQUIPMENT-basic-priced-1892.json (QA-passed) by tools/build-equipment.mjs — mapping/formatting only, no re-pricing and no invented items or stats. PRICE MAPPING: cost.value carries the source's Zenit integer (1 zenit = 1 penny per CURRENCY-zenit-and-sterling.md §3), and the human-readable £/s/d string is kept in each item's summary + description where the player reads it. Armor uses PFU's legacy attributes.primary/secondary shape (folded into def.attribute/mdef.attribute by ArmorMigrations on load), matching the base PFU basic-equipment packs. Mounts & Vehicles are priced in the source but have NO 1892 register name (generic printed labels) — OUT of scope, not shipped, flagged as a gap. No FU content is redistributed; no automation code.
